programs.description: On retrouve le corps de Michael Lee Smith abattu et abandonné sur le bas-côté de la route. La police doit démêler un tissu de mensonges pour partir à la recherche du tueur.

programs.title: Sentiers meurtriers
programs.subtitle: Un meurtre dans la réserve
programs.description: On retrouve le corps de Marshall Dent à peine enterré dans une réserve indienne suite à un appel anonyme ; les autorités craignent que ce soit le méfait d'un gang.

programs.title: La sombre histoire de...
programs.subtitle: L'imposteur orphelin
programs.description: Nick Rossi simule sa mort, adopte de nouvelles identités et sème le chaos. Sous le nom d'Arthur Knight, il tente son arnaque la plus audacieuse.

programs.title: La sombre histoire de...
programs.subtitle: Jodi Hildebrandt
programs.description: La psychologue Jodi Hildebrandt part en croisade contre la masturbation. Une alliance avec une maman vloggeuse s'avère désastreuse.

programs.title: La vallée des condamnés
programs.subtitle: Liste des meurtres
programs.description: Prison Valley est sous le choc après le meurtre du directeur de prison Tom Clements. Mais quel est le lien avec Nathan Leo, le livreur de pizza, mort deux jours plus tôt ?

programs.title: La vallée des condamnés
programs.subtitle: Complot meurtrier
programs.description: On retrouve le corps de Jim Durgan à Prison Valley et ni son ex-femme ni sa copine n'ont d'explications. L'enquête révèle un meurtre prémédité...

programs.title: FBI : enquêtes en immersion
programs.subtitle: Mis sous écoute
programs.description: Lorsqu'un gang criminel se met à régner sur une prison, l'agent Lewis découvre un univers perturbant où sexe, puissance et corruption sont rois.

programs.title: FBI : enquêtes en immersion
programs.subtitle: Kidnappés
programs.description: Un enlèvement amène le FBI dans l'Illinois, où le temps presse pour retrouver Larry et Connie Van Oosten. La vérité place la ville sous le choc.

programs.title: Sentiers meurtriers
programs.subtitle: Un meurtre mauvais pour les affaires
programs.description: En Illinois, MaryAnn Clibbery, une femme d'affaires accomplie, est brutalement assassinée ; un sac suspect flottant sur la rivière délivre tous les secrets de son meurtre.

programs.title: Sentiers meurtriers
programs.subtitle: Disparition inquiétante
programs.description: Une communauté de retraités dans l'Ohio est surprise lorsque Barbara Howe disparait un soir. Mais la police retrouve rapidement son corps dans le coffre de sa propre voiture.

programs.title: Mean Girl Murders
programs.subtitle: Reines de la danse
programs.description: Debbie Florez Narvaez, showgirl à Las Vegas, n'a pas peur de déranger. Lorsqu'elle disparaît, les enquêteurs se demandent si une rivale jalouse pourrait être responsable.

programs.title: Rivalités mortelles
programs.subtitle: Reine du rodéo
programs.description: Dalhart, Texas, 2017. Joel Frazier est le papa fier de deux anciennes reines du rodéo, Camie et Jamie Frazier. Mais un jour, il disparaît.

programs.title: Attraction mortelle
programs.subtitle: Coup de foudre éphémère
programs.description: A Tampa, en Floride, c'est le coup de foudre entre Chuck Rock et Beth Williams. Quand la relation tourne au vinaigre, Chuck devient la cible d'un mystérieux inconnu.

programs.title: Attraction mortelle
programs.subtitle: Un sombre complot
programs.description: Jenelle Potter n'a que peu d'amis et s'entiche de l'un d'eux mais ce n'est pas réciproque et le groupe la rejette. Quelqu'un dans l'ombre l'entraîne alors dans un complot sinistre.

programs.subtitle: La belle et le motard
programs.description: Laurie Bursey pense avoir trouvé le bonheur auprès de Kurt Bird, un voyou. Mais lorsqu'émerge le côté violent de Kurt, le bonheur se mue en peur.

programs.description: Everyone is putting on their leg warmers and joining the fun as Squirrel, Elephant, Hippo, Sheep and Rabbit shape up while touching their head, shoulders, knees, and toes, knees and toes.

programs.title: Songs and Rhymes
programs.subtitle: Dance Like a Baby
programs.description: Having fun dancing like a baby and singing along to fun songs that are memorable.

programs.title: Charlie and the Numbers
programs.subtitle: Charlie Meets the Number Seven
programs.description: Charlie and number Seven ride on Charlie's tricycle and call the wind, because Seven has lost her notes in the wind. Then they notice two fireflies drawing the symbol for 'Seven'.

programs.title: Charlie and the Numbers
programs.subtitle: Charlie Meets the Number Eight
programs.description: Numbers and counting turn into a fun adventure when Charlie visits the Numbers Kingdom.

programs.title: Charlie and the Numbers
programs.subtitle: Charlie Meets the Number Nine
programs.description: Numbers and counting turn into a fun adventure when Charlie visits the Numbers Kingdom.

programs.title: Charlie & the Shapes
programs.subtitle: Charlie Meets Diamond
programs.description: Diamond loves looking at himself in the mirror, but then the mirror breaks.

programs.title: Charlie & the Shapes
programs.subtitle: Charlie Meets the Queen of Hearts
programs.description: Charlie meets the Queen of Hearts who is looking for a star for on her wand.

programs.title: Charlie & the Shapes
programs.subtitle: Arrow
programs.description: Yellow rectangle, orange triangle and Charlie go searching for Arrow with the help of the map he has left for them. All they need to do is find the bushes, circle the tree, cross the bridge and go around the hill.

programs.title: Teeny and Tiny's Classroom
programs.subtitle: What's the Difference: Accordion
programs.description: Teeny and Tiny try to find the odd one out. Do you think you can help them?

programs.title: Teeny and Tiny's Classroom
programs.subtitle: Under the Handkerchief: Carrot
programs.description: Teeny and Tiny try to find out what is under the handkerchief and solve riddles.

programs.title: Teeny and Tiny's Classroom
programs.subtitle: What's the Difference: Lion
programs.description: Teeny and Tiny try to find out who does not belong in the line-up and solve riddles.

programs.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
programs.subtitle: Mouse
programs.description: What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game? Join Sophie to find out that a steering wheel goes with round objects along with an orange and a ball. Can you guess what sound a telephone, a train, a kettle and a…

programs.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
programs.subtitle: Picture
programs.description: Come help Hippa play the mixed-up picture game and find the missing part to complete the comb. What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game?

programs.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
programs.subtitle: Kitchen
programs.description: Can you guess what's hiding behind the hidden picture game? A baby chick, can you guess which tile is missing in the flower picture? What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game?

programs.title: Choopies
programs.subtitle: Beach
programs.description: The Choopies are happy and adventurous Scouts, in each episode they receive an assignment from their scout leader and go on a mission to bring back a different object.

programs.subtitle: House

programs.title: Choopies
programs.subtitle: Classical Music
programs.description: The scout leader sends the Choopies on a mission to collect different objects. When they all come back to the camp with what they have collected, they build something fun they all can play with!

programs.title: Little Lola Visits The City
programs.subtitle: Elephant Family Crossing the Crosswalk
programs.description: Lola helps a family of elephants cross the road and helps a cat off a tall tree.

programs.title: Little Lola Visits The City
programs.subtitle: Grey Car
programs.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Big wheel, helps Elephant get to the balloon shop and the park, has fun at the skate park and joins Max, Giraffe and Bear at the racetrack.

programs.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
programs.subtitle: Dog
programs.description: Lola has a fun and whacky time at the farm as she meets the animals and finds out about life there. The cheerful animals are always happy to have fun and help Lola explore fruits, vegetables, vehicles, foods and more.

programs.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
programs.subtitle: Rooster
programs.description: Lola has a fun and whacky time at the farm as she meets the animals and finds out about life there. The cheerful animals are always happy to have fun and help Lola explore fruits, vegetables, vehicles, foods and more.

programs.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
programs.subtitle: Cat
programs.description: Lola has a fun and whacky time at the farm as she meets the animals and finds out about life there. The cheerful animals are always happy to have fun and help Lola explore fruits, vegetables, vehicles, foods and more.

programs.title: Snail Trail
programs.subtitle: Firefly
programs.description: Mr Snail explores fireflies at night, but he is afraid of the dark and his torch has gone out. Mr Snail sees the glowing friends he meets and learns the special language of lights, enjoying the magical firefly song.

programs.title: Snail Trail
programs.subtitle: Butterflies
programs.description: Mr Snail meets a beautiful butterfly, a caterpillar and a cocoon. He wonders how they can be related when they look so different. The butterfly lays an egg, a caterpillar hatches and spins a cocoon.

programs.title: Snail Trail
programs.subtitle: Mole
programs.description: Mr Snail explores moles in a cauliflower field. Who's digging all the holes in the field? Join Mr Snail as he meets grandma mole and discovers that moles live underground. There they search for food and feel safe. Play…

programs.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
programs.subtitle: Ancient Egypt
programs.description: Lale and Lolu visit the magical world of Ancient Egypt with its hieroglyphics, pyramids and colossal statues.

programs.title: Pix & Leo
programs.subtitle: Grape Adventure
programs.description: Pix and Leo go to a lot of trouble trying to get a bunch of grapes hanging from a tall tree. Mama bird also has her eyes on the grapes. Who will get to the grapes first?

programs.title: Maya and Yaya
programs.subtitle: Jump Rope
programs.description: Yaya wants to jump rope, but is having a hard time and falls down.

programs.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
programs.subtitle: A Tambourine Twister
programs.description: Today, a tambourine arrives on Zeina's doorstep, and she has forgotten what you use it for. In their search for the answer, Zeina and her best friend Roy discover a hilarious use for the object.

programs.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
programs.subtitle: The Case Of The Confused Garden Hoe
programs.description: A garden hoe arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that a garden hoe is used for playing golf... is it?

programs.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
programs.subtitle: The Whimsical Whisk
programs.description: A whisk arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that a whisk is used for mixing.

programs.title: Mike's Bike
programs.subtitle: Bike Puzzle
programs.description: Johnny has taken apart his bicycle but can't seem to put it back together again. He turns to his good friend Mikey for some help.

programs.title: Mona & Sketch
programs.subtitle: Archeologist
programs.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become archaeologists. Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a shovel and a sieve! Help Mona dig in the ground and discover an ancient treasure.

programs.title: Mona & Sketch
programs.subtitle: Carpenter
programs.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out on an adventure to become carpenters. Sketch scribbles a tool box, wooden planks and tools. Step into the workshop and build a table and chair.

programs.title: Mona & Sketch
programs.subtitle: Prince and Princess
programs.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become a prince and princess.

programs.title: Billy Bam-Bam
programs.subtitle: Leaves
programs.description: As leaves fall from the trees, Billy and Bam-Bam play catch and dance in the rain of leaves.

programs.title: Billy Bam-Bam
programs.subtitle: The Band
programs.description: Billy and Bam-Bam have fun preparing a delicious fruit salad from grapes, strawberries and oranges.

programs.title: Tiny Bunch
programs.subtitle: Sheep's Bathing Suit
programs.description: Baby and Sheep want to go for a swim in the lake, but Sheep can't find her orange bathing suit, so Baby and Sheep go searching for everything that is orange.

programs.title: Tiny Bunch
programs.subtitle: The Friendship Song
programs.description: Giraffe and Baby want to sing the friendship song together. Pretty soon the entire bunch are singing and playing to the catchy tune.

programs.title: Tiny Bunch
programs.subtitle: Everyone Was Busy That Day
programs.description: Baby wants to play with his friends, but they are all busy. Squirrel is working in his garden, Giraffe is cleaning her roof and Hippo is painting his boat.

programs.title: Bath Tubbies
programs.subtitle: What's in the Water?
programs.description: While having fun sailing on a raft, Ducky, Ellie, and Froggy notice the sun is tired and decide to head back home, but then they see a round and white reflection appear in the water.

programs.title: Bath Tubbies
programs.subtitle: Goggles
programs.description: Ducky, Ellie, and Froggy are covered with paint after painting, so it is time to have fun scrubbing themselves in the bath, but Ducky needs goggles as he is afraid of getting soap in his eyes while shampooing.

programs.title: Bath Tubbies
programs.subtitle: Fill a Bath
programs.description: Cloud comes to fill the tub with rain when Ducky, Ellie, and Froggy want to have a bath. They all get surprised when the water disappears, so now the friends need help to find the cap and keep all the water.

programs.title: Look What I Found
programs.subtitle: Parade
programs.description: The friends have fun playing with a pot and a wooden spoon. The pot flips over, turning into a drum.

programs.title: Look What I Found
programs.subtitle: Horse
programs.description: The friends have fun sweeping with a broom that turns into a happy horse that giddy ups among lovely mountains and trees, and crosses over a river and cool waterfall, before reuniting with his amazing family.

programs.title: Look What I Found
programs.subtitle: Train Ride
programs.description: The friends have fun playing with colourful chairs that turn into train seats. The train gets stuck on a mountain and the animals help push it along to bring them safely back home.
